Two lands, one bottle.

OILERS joins the groves of the Western Cape with the ancestral memory of the Eastern Cape. One gives the fruit its body, the other gives the oil its meaning.

The Body • Terroir

Western Cape agricultural mastery

World-class groves, harvested at the right moment and pressed cold within hours. The result is an oil that is bright, balanced and clean on the finish.

  • SA Olive CTC certified extra virgin
  • Acidity below 0.8%
  • Cold first press, hand harvested
The Soul • Heritage

Eastern Cape sovereign heritage

The AmaXesibe clan stands behind this brand: Mount Ntsizwa above, the Mtamvuna River below. Sovereignty and independence are the standard every bottle is held to.

  • Mount Ntsizwa rises inside the monogram
  • The Mtamvuna River runs through the brand line
  • Praise names carried with every release

The sacred unboxing.

The ritual begins before the bottle does. A rigid matte black box opens to reveal the monogram in gold foil, pressed deep into the lid so you can feel it with a fingertip.

Inside, the bottle waits under a dark green leather strap and a wooden cap. Every layer is built to be opened slowly.
